summary.text: Justin Geiser is the Democratic candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 31 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Ron Fowler.
A U.S. Marine Corps veteran, he advanced from the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary.

paragraphs.text: Justin Geiser was born in Missouri and grew up in Garden City, according to his Ballotpedia survey responses.
He served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 2006 to 2010, then studied at MiraCosta College and San Diego State University, where he earned a bachelor's degree in psychology in 2018.

He later moved back to Missouri, bought a home in Blue Springs and worked for the federal government, including at the Federal Emergency Management Agency, a job he said he lost in August 2025 because of federal workforce cuts.
In the survey, Geiser said his key priorities include increasing funding for public schools, raising teacher pay and moving away from standardized testing.
